## About
Sherman Oaks Auto Center is a neighborhood repair shop on Van Nuys Blvd in Sherman Oaks. We handle complete auto repair for foreign and domestic cars, from oil changes and brakes to check engine diagnosis and factory scheduled services.
We're also a smog station, and we're an official brake adjusting station and official lamp adjusting station. If something isn't right with your visit, please let us know. Call us to ask about your car.

## Services
- Smog test: Smog testing done at our smog station.
- Check engine, ABS and SRS lights: We diagnose check engine, ABS and SRS lights.
- Factory scheduled services: Factory scheduled maintenance for your car.
- Complete auto repair: Repair work for foreign and domestic cars.
- Brake adjusting: We're an official brake adjusting station.
- Oil change: Routine oil change service.
- Shocks, suspension and electrical: Work on shocks, suspension and electrical systems.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We do complete auto repair on both foreign and domestic cars.

Q: Can I get a smog test here?
A: Yes. We're a smog station and do smog tests at the shop.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 4715 Van Nuys Blvd in Sherman Oaks.
